verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cloud creative platform like Runway, but the evidence pack documents no bulk account or project export, no data-takeout feature, and no exit path. Per-generation output formats such as ProRes, PNG sequences and HDR profiles are an adjacent capability, not an export of all user data. One community comment raises project-export concerns, but that is a worry rather than evidence either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
